explication: Kor is a CLI and Prometheus exporter for finding unused Kubernetes resources. A user runs a resource subcommand or requests a combined scan; the CLI initializes Kubernetes clients and options, resource analyzers identify candidates, and results are formatted for output or optionally deleted. The README also documents Slack notifications and broad resource coverage. Several resource implementations and the exporter internals were not sampled, so their links are documented or shown as unverified rather than inferred from naming alone.
